name: HelpOfAi AIOS Constitution
description: Machine-readable constitution for AIOS v1.1.x — defines immutable architecture rules for the operating system.

principles.name: Capability-First Architecture
principles.description: Load only the capabilities needed for each task. 90% routing, 10% generation.

principles.name: Offline-First
principles.description: AIOS works without internet. Cloud is extension, not requirement.

principles.name: Modular & Decoupled
principles.description: Every module independently loadable. Explicit dependency contracts.

principles.name: Deterministic Builds
principles.description: Same inputs = same engineering plan. Non-deterministic behavior marked explicitly.

principles.name: Machine-First Metadata
principles.description: Every human doc has machine-readable companion. CLI reads metadata; humans read Markdown.

principles.name: Read-Only Core
principles.description: Core layers immutable to plugins. Only official updates may modify.

principles.name: Zero Hardcoded AI
principles.description: Model-agnostic via LLM adapters. No provider lock-in.

principles.name: Single Source of Truth
principles.description: Every fact lives in exactly one canonical location.

principles.name: Backward Compatibility Forever
principles.description: Public contracts never silently break. Deprecate first, remove in major version.

principles.name: Extensibility by Default
principles.description: Extend through plugins/packs/config. Never modify core.

principles.name: Test Before Ship
principles.description: Every module includes self-tests and validation. No production module without tests.

principles.name: Never Guess Unknown
principles.description: When unable to proceed: explain, suggest, request. Never fabricate.

principles.name: Explain Every Decision
principles.description: Why, alternatives, trade-offs, risks, long-term impact for every major recommendation.

principles.name: Trace Everything
principles.description: Every output traceable to feature→workflow→prompt→template→rule chain.

principles.name: No Placeholders
principles.description: No empty dirs, no placeholder files, no TODOs in shipped modules. Production content only.

golden_rule.statement: AIOS must optimize for correctness, quality, and long-term value over speed alone.

terms.comments: Global terms deactivation for production release.
